protocols.description: A set of strings representing HTTP protocols.

continue_on_detection.description: If true, the guardrail will not block the request or response. Sanitization data and details will still be visible via kong logs. You can expect this field to work coherently with `sanitization_mode` parameter.

stop_on_error.description: Stop processing if an error occurs.

recover_redacted.description: Whether to recover redacted data. This doesn't apply to the redacted output.

rejection_mode.description: Controls block response format and status code. 'none' returns 400 with plain text block reason, 'stealth' 403 without details and 'verbose' returns 403 with rich JSON details.In streaming mode, the final SSE chunk includes finish_reason='blocked_by_guard' and 'verbose' will include a 'guardrail_result' metadata entry under 'data.choices[0]' in OpenAI format.

sanitization_mode.description: The sanitization mode to use for the request

scheme.description: The protocol can be http and https

timeout.description: Connection timeout with the sanitizer service.

block_if_detected.description: Whether to block requests containing PII data

redact_type.description: What value to be used to redacted to

proxy_scheme.description: The proxy scheme to use when connecting. Only `http` is supported.

auth_username.description: The username to authenticate with, if the forward proxy is protected by basic authentication.

auth_password.description: The password to authenticate with, if the forward proxy is protected by basic authentication.

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should not be proxied.

http_proxy_host.description: A string representing a host name, such as example.com.

http_proxy_port.description: An integer representing a port number between 0 and 65535, inclusive.

https_proxy_host.description: A string representing a host name, such as example.com.

https_proxy_port.description: An integer representing a port number between 0 and 65535, inclusive.

allow_all_conversation_history.description: If false, will ignore all previous chat messages from the conversation history.

keepalive_timeout.description: The keepalive timeout for the established http connnection

anonymize.description: List of types to be anonymized

custom_patterns.description: List of custom patterns to be used for anonymization

skip_logging_sanitized_items.description: Whether to log sanitized items in the Kong log policies. Turn it on if you want to hide sensitive data from logs.

consumer_group.description: If set, the policy will activate only for requests where the specified consumer group has been authenticated. (Note that some policies can not be restricted to consumers groups this way.). Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the authenticated Consumer Groups

route.description: If set, the policy will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route. Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the route being used.

service.description: If set, the policy will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service. Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the Service being matched.

consumer.description: If set, the policy will activate only for requests where the specified has been authenticated. (Note that some policies can not be restricted to consumers this way.). Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the authenticated Consumer.
